name: Sticky Split
description: The first clip is pulled apart down the middle like melted cheese: the halves part slowly while the picture between them stretches into a gooey web, which opens into glossy strings that thin out, sag and snap one by one, until the halves slide off and leave the second clip. Drive `progress` from 0 to 1.

inputs.name: second
inputs.description: Incoming clip (same size as the first)

params.name: strings
params.description: Number of strings across the height of the frame

params.name: sag
params.description: How much the strings sag under their weight

params.name: gloss
params.description: Strength of the shading, glossy highlight and shadow of the strings

params.name: seed
params.description: Random seed: another value gives other strings
